blurb: Guests join a day tour from Toronto to Niagara Falls including coach transport, a licensed guide, and free time at the falls. Optional add-ons include a helicopter tour over the falls, Skylon Tower observation deck tickets, and boat rides. Tours offer various packages with different inclusions and durations around 9 hours door to door.
